question: According to the Constitution of India, in which of the following matters can only Union Legislature make laws?
solution:
The correct answer is " **Post and Telegram** ". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The function of the legislative is to form **policies and laws** that will govern the nation.
